name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Related views of one page, read one at a time.

use_it_when: Related views of one page, read one at a time.
use_something_else_when: The reader needs several sections open at once → Accordion.

rules: Panel swap is fade only: never crossfade, never slide both. The leaving panel is removed (display:none) before the new one fades in.
Keyboard: Tab reaches each trigger; Enter/Space activates.
One indicator. One .tab-indicator per tablist, 2px of --primary-500, moved with transform and width; never an underline per tab.
Views of one page. Tabs switch what one page shows; going to another page is Navigation.
